testsuite.name: ./gradlew test -PforceTests --no-build-cache (both flavors)
testsuite.system-out: The build's own gate, run once by ./tools/loop/gate.sh (evidence/gate.log, LOOP-GATE line). gate.sh derives a suite's tally from a summary line; Gradle prints none, so its own loop-gate tally reads tests=0 and the numbers are summed here from what Gradle wrote: app/build/test-results/testMobileDebugUnitTest/*.xml and .../testAutomotiveDebugUnitTest/*.xml, 286 classes each, `tests=` summed to 2097 per flavor and `failures=` to 0 in both. -PforceTests makes the run re-execute rather than report a cached result (guidelines/Build.md §4).
